g.text: Does the matched-time proposal gain survive independent source-bank fits?

g.text: Four-bank conjunction: SUPPORTED · four independent 128-board draws · one finite rule family

text.style: font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: BP AdamW, original 4,000-update fit; bank-specific support and temperature; frozen kernels and source-selected proposal caps

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: All methods share the same saved permutation starts. Source median times must match within 5%; fresh target medians within 10%.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: One common fresh 4,096-input cohort, three search seeds per input, 20 chains. All earlier Loki search and calibration keys are excluded.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Bounds are 98.75% one-sided per bank: familywise 95% lower endpoints, and separately 95% upper endpoints; not a joint two-sided 95% interval.
